creator: Alexander Holm
title: Salamander Grand Piano (Yamaha C5)
usageInVoiceLine: VoiceLine bundles 28 original MP3 note samples (velocity layer 8) for offline keyboard playback. The playback engine interpolates/transposes pitch and controls sample gain and envelope; original sample MP3 bytes are retained.
changes: Playback pitch/speed, gain and release envelope are adjusted by the playback engine. Audio source samples are not edited or re-encoded.
